name: bluebridge-sites
description: Develop marketing plans, save authorized planning documents, and inspect websites through Blue Bridge Sites. Website editing and publication remain separate.

defaultPrompt: Help me prioritize my marketing content
interface.longDescription: Read registered organization guidance and marketing documents, discuss goals and priorities, and save working plans, decisions, questions and planned work when the backend is enabled and you explicitly consent as an organization owner/editor. Resume from repository-owned records in another session. Inspect website draft status and source. Website editing, build submission, analytics ingestion and social publishing remain unavailable through these tools; human approval/publication stay separate.
